title: Extreme Values of Quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions over Monic Irreducible Polynomials in $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$
summary: In this paper, we establish a new $Ω$-result for the values $|L(σ,χ_P)|$ of quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions at and near the central point, where \[ σ=\frac12+\fracκ{\ln g}, \qquad κ\geq 0, \] and $P$ ranges over monic irreducible polynomials associated with hyperelliptic curves of genus $g$ over a fixed finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$.
